title: King of the Beasts, Aya Anbesa (Is the grass green or blue?)
title_native: ንጉስ ኣራዊት ኣያ ኣንበሳ (እቲ ሳዕሪ ቀጠልያ ድዩ ሰማያዊ?)
logline: When a stubborn donkey and a clever leopard quarrel over whether the grass is blue or green, King Aya Anbesa delivers a surprising verdict that teaches a timeless lesson about wasting wisdom on fools.
audience: Tigrinya-speaking families in the diaspora and home regions watching on mobile screens, especially parents sharing heritage tales with children aged 6–12.
intent: To delight audiences with a humorous fable and leave them reflecting on the wisdom of avoiding pointless arguments with those who refuse to see the truth.

style.block: Warm hand-painted storybook illustration, gouache texture, soft grain, rich vibrant greens and warm ochres, golden ambient daylight, fairytale aesthetic.
style.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, text, signage, watermark, modern objects, dark gritty tone, neon lighting

characters.name: Aya Anbesa
characters.description: an old, calm, dignified lion with a thick dark-golden mane, a few grey hairs on the muzzle, kind amber eyes, and a simple woven gold band on his head.

characters.name: Adgi
characters.description: a stubborn grey donkey with a white muzzle and belly, long dark-tipped ears, a short bristly mane, and a small red tassel on his halter.

characters.name: Nebri
characters.description: a slender, clever leopard with a golden coat and black rosettes, bright green eyes, and a long curved tail.

narration.style_prompt: Read warmly, unhurriedly, and expressively in the style of a grandparent telling a fable to children, with gentle humor during the argument and deep calm for the verdict.

cues.caption: instrumental Ethiopian folk tale underscore, playful krar plucking, soft masenqo drone, gentle hand percussion, warm and light, sparse texture with no strong lead melody, builds a little in the middle, quiet pause, warm resolving theme at the end
cues.purpose: Playful underscore that leaves room for the voice; lifts during the quarrel, drops for the verdict, returns warm for the lesson.

shots.reason: Establishes the tranquil highland forest setting and classic fable atmosphere.
shots.image_prompt: A serene highland forest meadow in full daylight, tall green grass blowing in a soft breeze beneath sweeping acacia trees under bright sunny skies.

motion.prompt: camera slowly pans right across the vibrant green meadow

narration.text: ነበረያ ነበረ! ኣብ ሓደ ዓቢ ጫካ፣ ኩሎም እንስሳታት ብሰላም ዝነብሩሉ ቦታ ነበረ።
narration.english: Long ago, in a great forest, all animals lived together in peace.

shots.beat: King Aya Anbesa on his rock
shots.reason: Introduces the respected and fair ruler of the forest kingdom.
shots.image_prompt: Aya Anbesa sitting regally atop a smooth stone outcrop surrounded by lush green foliage, gazing forward with a peaceful demeanor.

motion.prompt: camera pushes in slowly toward Aya Anbesa as he breathes calmly

narration.text: መራሒኦምን ንጉሶምን ድማ ኣያ ኣንበሳ ነበረ። ብፍትሓውነቱ ኣብ ቅድሚ ኩሎም ዓቢ ክብሪ ነበሮ።
narration.english: Their ruler was King Aya Anbesa, respected by all for his justice.

shots.reason: Sets up the encounter between the donkey and the leopard in the meadow.
shots.image_prompt: Adgi the donkey and Nebri the leopard standing together in the open meadow, surrounded by deep green grass beneath clear blue daylight.

motion.prompt: camera gently pans left as the two animals face each other

narration.text: ሓደ መዓልቲ፣ ኣድጊን ነብርን ኣብ ሓደ ሜዳ ተራኺቦም ከዕልሉ ጀመሩ።
narration.english: One day, the donkey and the leopard met chatting in a green meadow.

shots.beat: Adgi claims the grass is blue
shots.reason: Captures the absurdity of the donkey claiming the green grass is blue.
shots.image_prompt: Adgi the donkey pointing his hoof down at the clearly bright green grass, raising his snout stubbornly with confidence.

motion.prompt: Adgi nods his head assertively as camera pushes in slightly

narration.text: ኣድጊ ነቲ ኣብ እግሮም ዘሎ ሳዕሪ እናረኣየ፣ «እዚ ሳዕሪ እዚ ሰማያዊ እዩ» በለ።
narration.english: Looking at the grass at their feet, the donkey said, 'This grass is blue.'

shots.reason: Shows Nebri's disbelief and assertion that the grass is green.
shots.image_prompt: Nebri the leopard looking confused and amazed, looking down at the green grass and extending a paw in protest.

motion.prompt: Nebri tilts his head in disbelief, camera pans right gently

narration.text: ነብሪ ተገሪሙ፣ «ኣይፋልካን፣ እዚ ሳዕሪ እዚ ቀጠልያ እዩ፣ ዓይንኻ ድዩ ተበላሽዩ?» ኢሉ መለሰሉ።
narration.english: Astonished, the leopard replied: 'No! This grass is green. Are your eyes broken?'

shots.reason: Shows the escalated quarrel leading them to seek royal arbitration.
shots.image_prompt: Adgi and Nebri walking side-by-side along a grassy hill path towards a majestic rock formation in warm afternoon sun.

motion.prompt: camera tracks forward behind them as they walk toward the royal rock

narration.text: ክርክሮም ናብ ባእሲ ተቐየረ። «ንዑ ናብ ንጉስና ኣያ ኣንበሳ ንኺድ» ተባሃሂሎም ከዱ።
narration.english: Their quarrel grew fierce. 'Let us go to King Aya Anbesa for judgment!'

shots.reason: Brings the conflict before the calm and listening King Lion.
shots.image_prompt: Adgi speaking eagerly in front of Aya Anbesa who rests on his rock seat, with Nebri standing nearby waiting quietly.

motion.prompt: camera slowly tilts up from Adgi to Aya Anbesa listening intently

narration.text: ኣድጊ ቀዲሙ፣ «ኦ ንጉስና! እዚ ሳዕሪ ሰማያዊ ምዃኑ እናነገርክዎ ይካትዓኒ ኣሎ» በሎ።
narration.english: The donkey spoke first: 'O King! He disputes that the grass is blue.'

shots.reason: Delivers the key dramatic turning point where the King agrees with the donkey.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of Aya Anbesa looking dignified and serious, speaking calmly under soft golden sunlight.

motion.prompt: Aya Anbesa nods slowly while speaking, camera remains steady

narration.text: ኣያ ኣንበሳ ንኽልቲኦም ጽን ኢሉ ምስ ሰምዐ፣ ብህድኣት «እወ፣ እቲ ሳዕሪ ሰማያዊ እዩ» ኢሉ ፈረደ።
narration.english: Aya Anbesa listened and calmly ruled: 'Yes, the grass is blue.'

shots.reason: Highlights the donkey's joyful exit and the leopard's hurt confusion.
shots.image_prompt: Adgi trotting away happily in the background, while in the foreground Nebri bows close to Aya Anbesa with a puzzled look.

motion.prompt: camera pulls back as Adgi leaves and Nebri turns toward the lion

narration.text: ኣድጊ እናሰሓቐ ከደ። ነብሪ ግን ሓዚኑ «ኦ ንጉስ፣ ስለምንታይ እዩ ሰማያዊ እዩ ኢልካ ፈሪድካ?» ኢሉ ሓተቶ።
narration.english: The donkey left laughing. Hurt, the leopard asked, 'Why say it is blue?'

shots.reason: The twist: the king admits he knows the grass is green, so the verdict was never about the grass.
shots.image_prompt: Aya Anbesa smiling warmly and wisely in rich golden sunset light, eyes filled with gentle understanding.

motion.prompt: Aya Anbesa smiles warmly, camera slowly pushes in

narration.text: ንጉስ ኣያ ኣንበሳ ፍሽኽ ኢሉ በሎ፦ «እቲ ሳዕሪ ቀጠልያ ምዃኑስ ኣጸቢቐ እፈልጥ እየ። መቕጻዕትኻ ግን ብዛዕባ ሕብሪ ሳዕሪ ኣይኮነን።»
narration.english: The king smiled: 'I know very well the grass is green. Your punishment is not about its colour.'

shots.reason: The moral, spoken by the lion to the leopard face to face, so the lesson is addressed to someone.
shots.image_prompt: Aya Anbesa leaning gently toward Nebri the leopard, who sits before him with ears lowered, on the lion's rock in warm golden late-afternoon light, green grass around them

motion.prompt: the lion lowers his head toward the leopard, the leopard's ears flatten slowly, camera fixed

narration.text: «ንስኻ ብልሒን ዓቕምን ዘለካ እንስሳ ክነስኻ፣ ምስ ሓደ ዓሻን ዘይርዳእን ኣድጊ ግዜኻ ኣጥፊእካ ክትካታዕ ስለዝወሰንካ እዩ!»
narration.english: 'It is because you, so wise and able, chose to waste your time arguing with a stubborn fool.'

shots.reason: Resolution: the leopard understands and apologises, closing the circle back in the peaceful forest.
shots.image_prompt: Nebri the leopard bowing his head respectfully before Aya Anbesa on the rock, then the wide peaceful green meadow and acacia trees at golden hour

motion.prompt: the leopard bows slowly, grass sways in the breeze, camera pulls back gently

narration.text: ነብሪ ነቲ ጥበብ ንጉሱ ተረዲኡ፣ ይቕረታ ሓቲቱ ከደ።
narration.english: The leopard understood his king's wisdom, asked forgiveness, and went on his way.
